senses.gloss: m. (מָחָה; cmp. τρίβων, Lat. tritus) tried, skilled, expert, practical.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 5a:1">Snh. 5ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 25b:18">R. Hash. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ לרבים</he> recognized by the public as an experienced judge.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 25b:18">Ib.</cite> <he>אין לך מ׳ וכ׳</he> there can be no expert more popular than Moses was.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 4:4">Bekh. IV, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Bekhorot 28b:16">28ᵇ</cite>) <he>מ׳ לב״ד</he> a lawyer approved by a court.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 27a:1">Ab. Zar. 27ᵃ</cite> top <he>רופא מ׳</he> a practical physician (that has a reputation at stake).
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 27a:1">Ib.</cite> <he>אם היה מ׳ לרבים</he> if he is a recognized practitioner.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 6:2">Sabb. VI, 2</cite> <he>קמיע שאינו מן המ׳</he> an amulet which is not issued by an approved person; <cite ref="Shabbat 53b:2">ib. 53ᵇ</cite> <he>קמיע שאינו מ׳</he> an unapproved amulet; <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 4:10">Tosef. ib. IV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 5:10">V</cite>), 10 <cite ref="M00519"><he>מוּמְחָא</he></cite>. Sabb. l. c. <he>מ׳ לאדם</he> of approved effect on human beings. Y. ib. VI, 8ᵇ top <he>קמיע זה מ׳</he> this amulet is approved.—

<cite ref="Mishnah Eruvin 5:5">Erub. V, 5</cite> (<cite ref="Eruvin 58b:12">58ᵇ</cite>) <he>אלא מן המ׳</he> (Ms. O. <he>אלא מ׳</he>, v. Rashi a. l.) only one of the best of the expert class; (oth. opin. v. Bart. a. l.).—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 30">Gen. R. s. 30</cite> <he>צדיק ומ׳</he> a righteous man and at the same time a practical man; a. fr.—Pl. <he>מוּמְחִים</he>, <he>מוּמְחִין</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 3:1">Snh. III, 1</cite> (<cite ref="Sanhedrin 23a:18">23ᵃ</cite>) <he>כשרים</he> (<cite ref="A00516"><he>או</he></cite>) <he>מ׳</he> (Bab. a. Y. ed. <he>מ׳ מפי ב״ד</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 1) men otherwise qualified and (or) authorized by the court; expl. ib. 23ᵃ <he>אם היו כשרין נעשו כמ׳</he> if not disqualified (on account of kinship or bad conduct) they are to be considered as if they were authorized judges; a. e.—[<cite ref="M00520"><he>מומחה</he></cite>, <cite ref="M00519"><he>מומחא</he></cite>, <cite ref="Shabbat 58a">Sabb. 58ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="M00860"><he>מָחֵי</he></cite>.]
